import Foundation.RiemannQuadraticStripEvolution
import OAI.NumberTheory.DirichletL.Nonvanishing
import Lean

open OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation

theorem stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_strip (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : RiemannEvenFlow.flow 1 t z = 0) :
    z.im ^ 2 ≤ max ((9/16 : ℝ) - 2*t) 0 :=
  RiemannQuadraticStripEvolution.conditional_seven_eighths_strip
    (fun _ hs => OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re hs) t ht z hz

theorem stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_real_zeros (t : ℝ) (ht : 9/32 ≤ t)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : RiemannEvenFlow.flow 1 t z = 0) : z.im = 0 :=
  RiemannQuadraticStripEvolution.conditional_seven_eighths_real_zeros
    (fun _ hs => OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re hs) t ht z hz

open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  for name in [``stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_strip,
      ``stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_real_zeros] do
    let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms name
    for ax in axioms do
      unless ax == ``propext || ax == ``Classical.choice || ax == ``Quot.sound do
        throwError "Forbidden integrated transitive axiom {ax} in {name}"
    logInfo m!"INTEGRATED ACTUAL HEAT AUDIT PASSED: {name}; {axioms}"

set_option pp.universes true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.proofs true
#check @stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_strip
#check @stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_real_zeros
output_unabridged:
INTEGRATED ACTUAL HEAT AUDIT PASSED: stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_strip; [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
INTEGRATED ACTUAL HEAT AUDIT PASSED: stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_real_zeros; [propext,
 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]
stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_strip : ∀ (t : ℝ),
  LE.le.{0} 0 t →
    ∀ (z : ℂ),
      Eq.{1} (OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation.RiemannEvenFlow.flow 1 t z) 0 →
        LE.le.{0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} z.im 2) (Max.max.{0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (9 / 16) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 t)) 0)
stardust_upstream_quadratic_heat_real_zeros : ∀ (t : ℝ),
  LE.le.{0} (9 / 32) t →
    ∀ (z : ℂ), Eq.{1} (OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation.RiemannEvenFlow.flow 1 t z) 0 → Eq.{1} z.im 0
consequence: Actual H_t zeros satisfy Im(z)^2 <= max(9/16-2t,0), t>=0; all zeros real at every t>=9/32
